text.tspan: One down-the-line clip of one swing. AIcoach will tell you
what it sees, how sure it is, and what to practise.

svg.text: mp4 or mov · up to 15 seconds · one swing
Stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it. Off: the clip is deleted
after analysis, and only the result is kept.
The essentials from the filming guide.
From behind, along the target line. Not face-on.
On or parallel to the hands line.
On a tripod or propped on your bag.
Whole body and club in frame
Feet to club head, for the full swing.
Analysing state: the same page after "Analyse this swing"
Usually under a minute. You can leave this tab open and get back to your bucket.
